# humanymous

> humanymous is an Apache-2.0 reference implementation for reducing browser automation against an application you operate. The standalone Core engine combines browser, integrity, interaction, connection, and consistency evidence into an ALLOW, CHALLENGE, or DENY verdict. The Gate reverse proxy enforces its own request-time verdict at the edge and records decisions in a tamper-evident local audit log. Core and Gate share scoring code but do not observe identical evidence.

The project raises the cost of commodity automation; it does not prove that a caller is human or promise to stop coherent automation using a real browser and plausible network origin. Gate is an application-edge automation control, not a web application firewall, content delivery network, traffic-absorption service, or interactive human-verification product. The computational-work challenge is incomplete as a production recovery and accessibility path.
